Description: 

 
 We are looking for a passionate software research engineer to develop demos and conduct simulation studies for state-of-the-art artificial intelligence applications. 
 Responsibilities: 
 · Deliver high-quality work results on time 
 · Write well designed testable, efficient code 
 · Integrate developed feature/component into a demo system 
 · Develop use case studies in a simulation tool 
 · Proactive with project discussions and planning 
 · Propose ideas to improve identified problems/issues during the development process 
 
 
 Requirements: 
 · Excellent ability to program in C/C++ 

 · Ability to conduct in-depth simulation results analysis and document analysis results 
 · Knowledge of object tracking and data association methods preferred 
 · Knowledge of probabilistic environment modeling and detection methods preferred 
 · Knowledge of artificial intelligence/machine learning algorithms preferred 
 · One-year work experience or intern work experience preferred 

   Master degree in computer science or engineering or above
